    The BGRS Figure 13E bound cleaving diagram #

    This file encodes the seven-vertex bound diagram E in the proof of BGRS Figure 13. Its source has the single displayed relation alphaCenter ≫ betaCenter = 0.

    The explicit one-parameter family has dimension vector (2,1,1,3,1,2,1). In the order used below, its two nontrivial middle maps are

      tauUpper(c) = [1 0; 0 1; c 1],
  tauLower    = [1 1 0; 0 0 1].

    The four outer arrows are coordinate inclusions or projections. Their flag conditions force every morphism between parameters c,d to be scalar, while the remaining tauUpper equation is c*r = d*r. The calculation uses no division and is therefore valid in every characteristic.
